    21	#ifndef KIMG_PIC_P_H
    22	#define KIMG_PIC_P_H
    23	
    24	#include <QImageIOPlugin>
    25	#include <QDataStream>
    26	
    27	/**
    28	 * The magic number at the start of a SoftImage PIC file.
    29	 */
    30	static const qint32 PIC_MAGIC_NUMBER = 0x5380f634;
    31	
    32	/**
    33	 * How fields are distributed over the image.
    34	 *
    35	 * This information is not used by this image format code.
    36	 */
    37	enum PicFields {
    38	    NoPicture = 0, /**< No picture */
    39	    OddScanlines = 1, /**< Odd scanlines */
    40	    EvenScanlines = 2, /**< Even scanlines */
    41	    BothScanlines = 3 /**< Every scanline */
    42	};
    43	
    44	/**
    45	 * How the data for a channel is encoded.
    46	 */
    47	enum PicChannelEncoding {
    48	    Uncompressed = 0, /**< Image is uncompressed */
    49	    MixedRLE = 2 /**< Run length compression */
    50	};
    51	
    52	/**
    53	 * What components are encoded in a channel.
    54	 */
    55	enum PicChannelCode {
    56	    RED = 0x80, /**< Red channel */
    57	    GREEN = 0x40, /**< Green channel */
    58	    BLUE = 0x20, /**< Blue channel */
    59	    ALPHA = 0x10 /**< Alpha channel */
    60	};
    61	
    62	/**
    63	 * The header for a SoftImage PIC file.
    64	 *
    65	 * @private
    66	 */
    67	struct PicHeader {
    68	    /**
    69	     * Construct a valid header for a SoftImage PIC file.
    70	     *
    71	     * Note that the comment will be truncated to 80 bytes when written.
    72	     *
    73	     * @param _width    The width of the image in pixels
    74	     * @param _height   The height of the image in pixels
    75	     * @param _comment  A comment to add to the image
    76	     */
    77	    PicHeader(quint16 _width, quint16 _height, const QByteArray &_comment = QByteArray())
    78	        : magic(PIC_MAGIC_NUMBER)
    79	        , version(3.71f)
    80	        , comment(_comment)
    81	        , id("PICT")
    82	        , width(_width)
    83	        , height(_height)
    84	        , ratio(1.0f)
    85	        , fields(BothScanlines)
    86	    {}
    87	    /** Construct an invalid header. */
    88	    PicHeader() {}
    89	
    90	    quint32 magic; /**< Should be PIC_MAGIC_NUMBER */
    91	    float version; /**< Version of something (header? file format?) (ignored) */
    92	    QByteArray comment; /**< A free comment field (truncated to 80 bytes when
    93	                             written) */
    94	    QByteArray id; /**< The file format ID (should be "PICT") */
    95	    quint16 width; /**< The width of the image in pixels */
    96	    quint16 height; /**< The height of the image in pixels */
    97	    float ratio; /**< The aspect ratio: width/height of each individual pixel
    98	                      (ignored) */
    99	    PicFields fields; /**< The interlace type (ignored) */
   100	
   101	    /**
   102	     * Returns true if the @p magic and @p id fields are set correctly.
   103	     */
   104	    bool isValid() const {
   105	        return magic == PIC_MAGIC_NUMBER
   106	            && id == "PICT";
   107	    }
   108	
   109	    /**
   110	     * The length of the encoded data, in bytes.
   111	     */
   112	    static const qint64 encodedLength = 104;
   113	};
   114	
   115	/**
   116	 * Describes a channel in a SoftImage PIC file.
   117	 *
   118	 * @private
   119	 */
   120	struct PicChannel {
   121	    quint8 size; /**< Bits per component per pixel. */
   122	    PicChannelEncoding encoding; /**< How the channel's data is encoded. */
   123	    quint8 code; /**< Flag field to describe which components are encoded in
   124	                      this channel. */
   125	
   126	    /**
   127	     * Constructs a channel description for a SoftImage PIC file.
   128	     *
   129	     * @param _encoding  How the channel's data is or will be encoded.
   130	     * @param _code      What components are or will be encoded by this
   131	     *                   channel.
   132	     * @param _size      The number of bits used to encoded a single component
   133	     *                   for a single pixel in this channel (should be 8).
   134	     */
   135	    PicChannel(PicChannelEncoding _encoding, quint8 _code, quint8 _size = 8)
   136	        : size(_size)
   137	        , encoding(_encoding)
   138	        , code(_code)
   139	    {}
   140	    /**
   141	     * Constructs a default channel description for a SoftImage PIC file.
   142	     *
   143	     * This will have size set to 8, encoding set to Uncompressed and the code
   144	     * set to 0 (so that the channel does not encode any information).
   145	     *
   146	     * The result of this should not be written to a file without setting the
   147	     * encoding and channel fields correctly.
   148	     */
   149	    PicChannel()
   150	        : size(8)
   151	    {}
   152	};
   153	
   154	class SoftimagePICHandler : public QImageIOHandler
   155	{
   156	public:
   157	    bool canRead() const override;
   158	    bool read(QImage *image) override;
   159	    bool write(const QImage &) override;
   160	
   161	    QVariant option(ImageOption option) const override;
   162	    void setOption(ImageOption option, const QVariant &value) override;
   163	    bool supportsOption(ImageOption option) const override;
   164	
   165	    static bool canRead(QIODevice *device);
   166	
   167	    enum State {
   168	        Error,
   169	        Ready,
   170	        ReadHeader,
   171	        ReadChannels
   172	    };
   173	
   174	    SoftimagePICHandler()
   175	        : m_state(Ready)
   176	        , m_compression(true)
   177	    {}
   178	
   179	    bool readHeader();
   180	    bool readChannels();
   181	
   182	private:
   183	    State m_state;
   184	    QDataStream m_dataStream;
   185	    PicHeader m_header;
   186	    QList<PicChannel> m_channels;
   187	    // mostly used for writing:
   188	    bool m_compression;
   189	    QByteArray m_description;
   190	};
   191	
   192	class SoftimagePICPlugin : public QImageIOPlugin
   193	{
   194	    Q_OBJECT
   195	    Q_PLUGIN_METADATA(IID "org.qt-project.Qt.QImageIOHandlerFactoryInterface" FILE "pic.json")
   196	
   197	public:
   198	    Capabilities capabilities(QIODevice *device, const QByteArray &format) const override;
   199	    QImageIOHandler *create(QIODevice *device, const QByteArray &format = QByteArray()) const override;
   200	};
   201	
   202	#endif // KIMG_PIC_P_H
